package main

import("encoding/json"; "os"; "net"; "time"; "strings")

func main() {
 var input string
 if json.NewDecoder(os.Stdin).Decode(&input)!=nil {os.Exit(2)}
 parts:=strings.SplitN(input,"\n",2)
 path:=parts[0]
 _,readErr:=os.ReadFile(path)
 writeErr:=os.WriteFile(path,[]byte("tampered"),0600)
 dir,dirErr:=os.ReadDir("/")
 conn,networkErr:=net.DialTimeout("tcp",parts[1],50*time.Millisecond)
 if conn!=nil {conn.Close()}
 result:="capability-leak"
 if readErr!=nil && writeErr!=nil && (dirErr!=nil || len(dir)==0) && networkErr!=nil && os.Getenv("EVALRUNNER_SECRET")=="" && len(os.Environ())==0 {result="no-fs,no-network,no-env"}
 json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(result)
}
